title: UPWIND: reproducible annual PM2.5 exploration and North Carolina spatial evaluation
description: Open-source air-quality explorer and reproducible annual evidence workflow. Includes a cleaned EPA AQS snapshot, 160 North Carolina site-year observations at 23 stations (2018–2025), spatial holdout predictions, baseline comparisons, station-cluster bootstrap uncertainty, a three-page county evidence report, and input/output checksums. No hourly AQI, commute-window, school-exposure or causal traffic claim is supported. The 2025 observations are provisional. Apache-2.0 applies to UPWIND software; upstream EPA observations retain their attribution.
